hints.title: Partition Index Definition
hints.text: A split at index i divides the array into left part nums[0..i] and right part nums[i+1..n-1].

hints.title: Running Left and Right Sums
hints.text: With the total sum known, right_sum is total - left_sum at each split point.

hints.title: Single-Pass Comparison
hints.text: Traverse from index 0 to n - 2, updating left_sum and checking if left_sum >= right_sum.

hints.title: Running Sum Split Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass with constant extra memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing sum of slices at each index takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory by maintaining running sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate stops at index n - 2 so both split sides contain at least one element.
